title: In JetBrains YouTrack before 2026.2.19197 incorrect authorisation in the scripts debugger allowed workflow script…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains YouTrack before version 2026.2.19197 allows incorrect authorization in the scripts debugger. This flaw permits unauthorized disclosure and suspension of workflow scripts. The issue is classified as CWE-863 (Incorrect Authorization) and has a CVSS v3.1 score of 7.1, indicating high severity.
